# Recipe P4 — Apply & verify (G2)

**Facade:** `/sdd:p4`\
**Status:** ready

## Goal

Implement per ATDD → local verify → PR/CI → deploy → CD report → G2.

## Sequence

1. `/sdd:atdd-apply`
2. `/sdd:local-verify-report` (Fail → default stop; human-signed waiver only)
3. `/sdd:pr-submit`
4. `/sdd:pipeline-report phase=ci`
5. `/sdd:deploy-artifacts` (after merge)
6. `/sdd:pipeline-report phase=cd`
7. `/sdd:g2-decision-record`

## Outputs

Code increment, local/CI/CD reports, PR/deploy records, G2 decision record.
